draft.body:
The queue-with-backoff approach fits the ticket: deliveries are stored, retried for 24 hours and visible to the customer. One thing blocks the merge and two should be fixed with it.

**Not checked:** worker behaviour across a deploy restart; production delivery volumes.

sections.heading: ### Blocker · F1 · A retried delivery is sent without an idempotency key
sections.title: A retried delivery is sent without an idempotency key
sections.agent_title: A retried delivery is sent without an idempotency key
sections.agent_text: A retry re-sends the payload with no key, so a customer receives the event twice. See `jobs/DeliverWebhook.php:58`.

sections.heading: ### Should · F2 · No way to replay a delivery after the window closes
sections.title: No way to replay a delivery after the window closes
sections.text: After 24 hours a failed delivery is marked dead and nothing can send it again. Acceptance criterion 3 on ABC-231 asks for the customer to recover from a long outage.

sections.text: I reverted the retry and `tests/WebhookRetryTest.php:31` still passed, so it does not pin the behaviour.
